title: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party terá 2ª temporada
excerpt: O anime There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her (Yūsha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Itanode, Kokuhaku Shite Mita) teve sua segunda temporada confirmada.
